grades.quote: PMAs must also be readable by software to correctly access certain devices or to correctly configure other hardware components that access memory, such as DMA engines.
grades.reason: The passage is about RISC-V Physical Memory Attributes (PMAs). It says PMAs are platform-specific, that software must be able to read them to access devices correctly, and that cacheability attributes can be reconfigured by machine mode. It never says which attributes separate cacheable memory from device-style (I/O) accesses, so it gives only limited background.
